name: Draft Policy Nationalization Costs
query:
SELECT
    policy.company AS "Empresa:Data:220",
    policy.policy AS "Poliza:Data:120",
    policy.name AS "ID Policy:Link/Policy:180",
    costs.name AS "ID (Costs):Data:180",
    costs.provider AS "Provider:Data:180",
    costs.description AS "Description:Data:220",
    costs.reference AS "Reference:Data:160",
    costs.amount_nio AS "Amount NIO:Currency:140",
    costs.iva AS "IVA:Currency:120",
    costs.type AS "Type:Data:150"
FROM `tabPolicy` AS policy
INNER JOIN `tabPolicy Nationalization Cost` AS costs
    ON costs.parent = policy.name
    AND costs.parenttype = 'Policy'
    AND costs.parentfield = 'nationalization_costs'
WHERE policy.docstatus = 0
  AND policy.company IN %(companies)s AND costs.type IN %(types)s
ORDER BY
    policy.posting_date DESC,
    policy.name DESC,
    costs.idx ASC
